headline: Fierce Fighting Reopens Weathered Expanse as Mooring County Flares
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, fresh upheaval has erupted across the central and northern sectors. Weathered Expanse shattered its earlier stalemate with five base transfers over the last two hours, accompanied by an intense surge in mutual bloodshed that produced over thirty-two hundred casualties. Ground combat also flared sharply in Mooring County, where three base exchanges in two hours pressed Colonial forces back to a single contested stronghold against eleven Warden positions. Across the waterways, Fisherman's Row moderated its earlier frenzy down to two turnovers, while Godcrofts registered two base shifts of its own, leaving both island hexes harboring unoccupied ruins. Meanwhile, Stlican Shelf settled into a quieter posture following earlier turmoil, with Warden forces consolidating a sixth strategic base. A massive bloodbath persists unabated in Callahan's Passage, recording an astonishing five thousand six hundred casualties across two hours of accelerating combat without altering base lines, whereas prior Colonial conquests in Linn of Mercy and Farranac Coast have seen frontline movement cool to a crawl.
